description: Apply status enums to Audit, Nonconformity, CorrectiveAction, and Risk models

steps.description: Alter audits table to use AuditStatus enum
sql: ALTER TABLE "audits" DROP COLUMN "status", ADD COLUMN "status" "AuditStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PLANNED';

steps.description: Alter corrective_actions table to use CorrectiveActionStatus enum
sql: ALTER TABLE "corrective_actions" DROP COLUMN "status", ADD COLUMN "status" "CorrectiveActionStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING';

steps.description: Alter nonconformities table to use NonconformityStatus enum
sql: ALTER TABLE "nonconformities" DROP COLUMN "status", ADD COLUMN "status" "NonconformityStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN';

steps.description: Alter risks table to use RiskStatus enum
sql: ALTER TABLE "risks" DROP COLUMN "status", ADD COLUMN "status" "RiskStatus" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IDENTIFIED';

steps.description: Create composite indexes for tenant-scoped status queries
